text: Stella's is one of the first restaurants we came to when restaurants re-opened in Florida.  We have had breakfast here twice and both times have been fabulous.  The lox eggs Benedict was delicious - the poached eggs were cooked perfectly, the lox were super fresh and the hollandaise sauce was perfection.  My husband had the special, blueberry pancakes with granola, and he was very pleased.  He was even more excited to find out that they have legit maple syrup (from a tree not a corn syrup factory.  The service was attentive and friendly. I'm pretty sure we'll be coming back for breakfast or lunch again tomorrow.
Not kid friendly- no booster seats/high chairs.  Food is so-so.  This is likely a good place for a beer.

We went for lunch because how do you say no to $6 lunch specials?! Amazing. They make it super spicy if you ask them to so that was a huge plus for me. Best of all, their chicken and beef is from the halal section in restaurant depot-yes it's halal!!!

I came to Tennessee for a work trip for 5 days & I stayed here. Honestly, this is one of the best hotels I've stayed at. From the moment I walked in, I was in aw by how beautiful it is inside and the view of all the rooms. The staff is very friendly. Jeremiah was who I checked in with and he is super helpful. He gave me recommendations on several places to eat and visit. The breakfast in the mornings are absolutely delicious. There are so many options for people to chose from. I think my favorite part is the made to order omelette station. There is also a restaurant / bar in the hotel for guest to enjoy. 
The first night here I decided to grab a drink and I was waited on by Brittney. Since then all week we've talked and got to know one another. She is a super sweet employee and she really made my stay here feel welcomed. The room I got is also super roomy and spacious. I highly recommend this place to anyone who is staying in Franklin Tennessee! I plan on coming back soon to actually explore and I would seriously choose this hotel again!!

If you would like to go to the country's worst, look no further. McDonalds recently spent money on renovations, but it didn't help the service. They are the slowest. The help is rude and most of them really don't want to work. Bad manager and bad management. Something needs to be done. If you go here, you had better bring your own lunch. I am a delivery service driver. We talk to other drivers and none of us want to go there. While writing my review, I glanced to the right and OMG all of the 1 Stars. Utterly shameful! I am not alone. This is a disgrace to the McDonalds brand.
We LOVE Mexican food, but we did not care for this place. Chips are odd and our food was kinda bland. One thing they got right, the salsa!!!

I came in with a large group around 9:45 oso to be fair it was a bit of an unusual table however the waitress seem to be highly stressed my by the fact that she had to take 11 drink orders. We didn't order food and most people only had one drink yet she appeared overwhelmed by our group. Wasn't even very busy. They did poor a strong drink though and the drinks weren't bad.

I came here for my birthday Sunday night. Everything was great! What really caught my attention was the Laotian pork rice bowl. Not many people know about this small country. I'm Laos myself so I had to try it and.....WOW! It's pretty much Larb (Lao/Thai dish) packed with so much herbs. Perfect with a slice of lime. Ohhh, and don't forget to try their cocktail No.20 if you like something refreshing. Will be back again!

Late post...Came here with my sister when we were in town for the Mardi gras festivities. We were recommended to try this place out by one of the NOLA officers patrolling the area we were at. The food was pretty good. I had Juan's Flying Burrito, which was full of flavor. And our server was super nice, attentive, and patient with us while we decided on our meal. The wait time to get a table was long, but I'd say it was worth it.
Burgers are very very good with grill onions, shakes are good , fries are soso, location is very good close to the beach.
Great food, Great staff, all taking COVID precautions. We enjoyed our meal and the Detroit type food made us feel at home.

Slow and horrible service. Dirty. Will not be going back. Recently learned what they did to their employe and I'm not surprised. Poor kid... someone needs to check that place out and clean it up because it's ruining the Abington neighborhood!

Got the tuna poke bowl but I Built my one instead of one of the many options. They have fresh fish that is not local but it is responsibly sourced and you can ask the employees they will tell you where from. The ingredients are fresh. The employees were very kind and helpful since there are so many options and you can taste the sauces as well to make sure you get the one you want. They are very informative in helping you make a descision. It's in a nice area of town with street parking but I didn't see a parking lot so you'll have to pay to park on weekdays.
The owners and staff are super friendly here, the food is definitely the best Chinese food in the Rivergate area! If you like crab Rangoon's you have to try theirs!

Whatever you do, don't order online or through any food delivery service app. They'll mess your order up every time and you won't get items you pay for. Missing several items out of a 50+$ food order, on Mother's Day of all days. 
This is the third time I've had issues with this particular Bob Evans. 

The manager did say she would refund me but I will not eat here again.
Had a great lunch today with some friends. Delicious burgers and one of the best lemonades I've ever had!! My server Matt was fun and super great. I'd come back for sure!

This Sushi place was unusual for us. 

We ordered the chicken satay to start with, and I would never order that it again. The chicken was so overcooked and dry, it was almost inedible. It looked good though. 

Then when looking at the menu, I honestly couldn't find a Sushi roll and neither could Ben that we wanted so we both went with getting a make your own Sushi Burrito. Normally finding a roll is not an issue, especially for Ben. 

I did like the different options that you can pick and choose from when creating your own roll from sauces, veggies, proteins, wrap type, etc and we both order completely different types. I was very pleased with mine and since it is a burrito, it was too big for me to finish and I was going to take the rest home. BUT, still getting use to having to ensure your mask is on prior to getting up from your seat, I got distracted and left it on the table. :(  

So, we may not be back for traditional Sushi, but I am pretty sure we will be back for a Sushi Burrito.

Tomo is that neighborhood spot that's a keep in your rotation kinda restaurant. The service is really fast and our waitress was nice.

We chose to sit at the bar and watch the sushi chef. His slices of sashimi was amazing. Thick cuts and the sushi was so flavorful. There wasn't much showmanship with the sushi ,as we ordered a love boat and it usually comes in a boat but despite that, the rolls were tasty and sashimi fresh. Wonderful romantic night for me and the hubby.

Elmwood is an exciting addition to the Maplewood dining scene. I made reservations at 7:30 for my birthday dinner and we were not seated until about 7:45. It was a Friday night and quite crowded with nearly every table full and no seats at the bar. The restaurant is extremely dark with black walls and dim lights, so some people struggled to see the menu and it was nearly impossible to take a good picture of the food. When we were seated we were treated with the utmost care and attention. The menu is different and nothing quite jumped out at me at first, though I had heard online that they have great fried chicken livers. The menu is mostly small plates with some large entrees and the food is listed in order of size from smallest to largest portions. With only two people dining, we were unsure on how many dishes to order so we consulted with our waiter and he gave us good advice. We ordered the fried chicken livers, broccoli Caesar salad, and beef jerky skewers. The livers were brought out first, which was a mistake on the kitchen, so we were given the gnochetti for free later. The gnochetti actually turned out to be the star of the meal! The broccoli Caesar salad would have been much better if it were warm and the broccoli was not as tough. The chicken livers and beef skewers were good. There is street parking and a shared parking lot behind the restaurant. I enjoyed the ambiance at Elmwood- very dark and intimate- but the menu was just a bit off and I didn't feel the food wa

We came here right before closing, so that was probably why it was limited on the items they had left. I liked their shumai, which tasted very fresh. Their bakery options were just average. I wasn't blown away with amazement, but I would come back to try other items to see if anything else is worth coming back for.

Wow! They truly have a magic recipe. Don't know how, but every time I dine there, I'm blown away by the quality and flavor of their empanadas. The Ground Beef is my favorite but they have many other selections for vegetarians.

I have been going here the last few days after work. And the food is great. The Manger I'm assuming, named Julia. She is doing a great job. I can tell that there are newer people in training. But she's doing great keeping her patience with them. I will continue going here:)

I could make more money suing this place for their cleanliness during covid than I ever could gambling. I call it how I see it just like they only clean it if you can see it. Please do yourself a favor and stay at river city casino and hotel

It wasn't very busy and we had to wait for a table to be cleaned
Then we WAITED TO ORDER AND WAITED OVER TWENTY MINUTES FOR OUR BEER
so we left
It was ridiculous
People that came in after us got drinks while we waited

I don't understand why it took so long
There were not very many customers

Excellent breakfast! Ordered Hungry Man breakfast with pecan pancakes and it was amazing! Also ordered eggs and corned beef hash which was also very yummy. Service was excellent, restaurant is very clean.

The location is convenient to home but I feel like every time I go there something goes wrong. Tonight's waitress was not attentive and my Crete burger that I ordered was burnt when I asked for medium well. I ate most of it but I did mention when she finally came over. No offer for a discount or anything. I just feel like this location does not give a crap. Have never had the kind of issues at the ybor location like we do here. Very unfortunate since it's closer to home.

Ordered a Brooklyn style pizza tonight at 12:15
Received my pizza at 1:38 
Pizza was ice cold and horrible 
Could not tell where the green peper and onion were it was supposed to be half..
Hard and cold ! Burnt bottom 
Not happy at all definitely not worth $30


I would like to Thank Del Rossi for fixing the problem 
I appreciate them apologizing and re making it.
100 times so much better !
I will be ordering again

We entered the picnic and the music was absolutely awesome Tecno and trance music. The facility was packed out as we entered the bar. There was nobody at the door carding which was interesting- Sees that it's a bar and you dont want kids under age as their a liability. We're okay will head to the bar to order drinks- Even the owner didn't card us. I asked if they had any ciders on tap and 'he said I don't know, what kind do you want' I said what do you have he came back and said Hibiscus I said that's fine my girl friend said a number 11 which was an IPA but apparently it's up on the second floor (we've not been in over a year) rudely he says it's on second F****** floor, she said okay I'll get a number 3 from the wall menu. Our friend said I'll have the Hibiscus cider as well. Owner/bartender comes and brings two drinks and our friend asked where his was apparently that sparked rage in the owner as he's like what the F*** do you want, he said I ordered the Hibiscus Cider he said no you didn't, my friend asked if it was organic and the owner flipped out saying-  the whole F****** bar is organic. It was obvious it wasn't. Our friend said you can't talk to us like that, who's the owner? He  screamed and said 'I'm the F******  owner if you have a F****** problem you can get the F*** out of here, in fact get the  F*** out. It became very hostile on the owners part. I'm still in shock. If this is the face of this facility I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

First time. Got the chicken thigh/chorizo tacos... full of flavor.  My colleague got the corned beef and eggs and said it was the best he's had.  Since it was our first time our waitress brought us a plate sized pancake with streusel topping amazing.  Will come back the next time I'm in Tucson.
Great smoothies. I also like the breakfast toast. I do wish they start to grill their turkey sausage versus microwave. All that radiation defeats the purpose of this being a healthy place.

Great new place for authentic Chinese food in Santa Barbara! Tried their chicken platter, sour soup beef, roasted ribs, sizzling pot. The food is authentic, with great service. They have a music bar with singers, making it a pretty nice and special experience to have dinner there. There's also a special room where you can sing yourself with friends (KTV in Chinese), which I guess should be the only one in Santa barbara

Three tiny skewers and a very small portion of edamame for $20. When we asked the waitress about it her response was, "I don't make the menu." Feel totally ripped off and food was super cold, it also took us at least 30 minutes to get this awful service. Don't come here. Nohely checked on us all of two times and didn't even bother to give us napkins or silverware

Happy Hour has some really good selections for food and drink. I got boom boom shrimp for an appetizer and red fish with corn for dinner. The atmosphere is very friendly and sporty. The waitresses have a tiny uniform, which looked like a cheer leader skirt and shirt. I felt comfortable in or outside dining areas. The food was reasonably priced and it was really good. A good time was had by all at our year end party! I would go there again
If you want the largest and tastiest Mimosa in town, this is the place! The food is also very good, though a bit pricey for the quantity compared to other Boise offerings.

Early flight out - stopped to grab something to eat.  Grateful McDonald's was open.  There was a short line, but the gentleman taking orders did a great job of moving things along by utilizing 2 cash registers.  My food came relatively quick considering how busy it was.  A little spendy but it's the airport, so it's expected.  No complaints, just glad I got something in my stomach before the flight.
We absolutely loved this restaurant. The food was excellent! Loved the porkchops and squash. This will definitely be our go to restaurant when we come to Nashville every month.

I am writing this review strictly based off how amazing the Parisian Gnocchi was! 11/10 would HIGHLY Recommend! It was surely the highlight of my night. This is definitely a fine dining experience you should indulge in at least once. The servers are professional and super knowledgeable. I tried the Escargot (8/10), Steamed Mussels (7/10), and Roasted Monkfish (7/10). I also tried and loved two diff cocktails; cocktail #6 and a fortunate situation. Lovely drinks and they did not skimp on the liquor. The restaurant was following social distancing guidelines and I appreciated that. Overall I would recommend this for a date night, anniversary, or romantic night out. The ambiance is very cozy and indulging.

I've heard lots of great news about this place, and since it was on my way home I decided to pop by. It was pretty empty for lunch time, but I guess it's more of a dinner place than anything considering its location. I got tacos al pastor and flan, two things I consider when trying a new place out. The flavors and texture of the pastor were amazing, but it definitely felt like it was lazily butchered and I was upset by the lack of pineapple. The flan also seemed like the custard broke before baking, leaving it a bit grainy. I would definitely come back though since all the flavors were there and sometimes you catch people on an off day.
COVID precautions and service was great. Our server was quick and super helpful! Had the enchilada plate with the red sauce which was okay and complimentary chips and salsa were great!

Ok. This review is for the scones. I have NEVER had a more amazing scones like the ones they have here!! The blueberry and raspberry are especially amazing. You won't be disappointed if you get one :)

Stopped at this Panera Bread location while on a walk on West End. For a Friday evening it was fairly empty, which left plenty of room for open seating and quick service. 

The calm and quiet atmosphere was perfect for me to read a book and relax as I ate my dinner, I also saw several students and adults working on projects as well. The large dining area and WiFi make it great for a study group or personal work projects while you grab a light bite to eat.

I got the Chicken Tortellini Alfredo, it was a bit lukewarm to cold when I got it, but it was honestly so tasty that I decided to continue eating it. I also got a Chocolate Chip Cookie (yummmmm). I was very satisfied by the portion size and flavors of my food, and will definitely come back for a quiet bite to eat.

Went last week for lunch. Just ordered Hummus and the Deviled Eggs. Really enjoyed. I should stick to what I have said in the past that the appetizers are better then the main course. Had the Fried Chicken sandwich this evening. It was so dried out I felt like I was eating bones. Quite honestly a very small piece of what looked like dark meat when white would have been much better, I think.

I have always loved Portillo's ever since I went to my first one in Chicago.  I was so thrilled to find the location in Greenwood IN, in took me back to Chicago.  I know I can order anything on the menu and it will be awesome.  I can't recommend Portillo's enough to everyone.  Don't forget to try the chocolate cake you'll love it.

I went there with my boss for lunch.
It is a very cool place and I enjoyed the atmosphere.
Staff is very polite and helpful and it seems the place is pretty efficient.
I had salad with chicken breast.
The quality of the food was good and it was tasty.
Parking won't be an issue and I think it's a good spot for lunch or dinner.
Overall I enjoyed my experience and I'll definitely go back there!
I went there to try its spicy fish. After I ordered the fish, I waited for close to an hour,  but only to learn that they did not place my order yet, a complete waste of my time.

I walked into sportsman's and immediately got laughed at and mocked at by the staff because my friends and I just finished a hunt and were wearing camo. Not to mention my chair only had 3 legs. The food was under mediocre. I hope this review helps staff change their ways. Would love to go back once I hear all there stuff is together.
This is a great place. Amazing authentic menu. What a great menu for lots of options. Bring your own wine. Take your time   Enjoy the delicious fooD.
I Wanna Wok was one of three food trucks at our wedding.  The food and service was amazing, and I would recommend anyone looking to go that route for catering to consider them.

After walking in I was debating to order something because the restaurant was so dirty it had a smell so I decided to give it a chance and what a mistake it was after eating  the food I was sick for two days

We are so sad to see this place in its original location go, but thankful that they will be opening up again soon right down the street. The service is a little rough lately between the demand to get one last meal in on the bayou and What I'm sure is a small transition of staff due to the relocation. You can choose to sit inside or out, just know there is a threat of bugs when enjoying a dinner on the bayou. We were actually provided bug-spray when we mentioned it! But the food perfectly matches the atmosphere and I've never chosen to sit inside despite a few mosquito bites. The food is absolutely amazing! We've tried everything from the fried green tomato's to the bread pudding dessert and never been disappointed. They also have an extensive collection of craft beer and a staff knowledgeable enough to lead you to something you'll like. If it's on tap you're always welcome to a sample before you commit. Sad to see the authenticity of the location disappear, but I know we will follow them regardless because the food never disappoints!

Greetings fellow users of the app yelp,

Tonight my comrades and I dined at the establishment known as Yard House. It was my friends birthday, but he asked I not use his name. The service was very slow and our waiter was a bit awkward. Beyond the slow service the food was great. Jimmy, the birthday boy, demanded we order a onion ring tower. Gang, let me tell you we f**ked that s**t the f**k up! I ordered a burger that I ate. 3 stars
Food was huge and tasty. The server was very nice and polite. The place is cozy and sweet. We enjoyed our food here. The drinks were not too special.

I want to mention, I love their bread! I love their vodka sauce! Usually the servers are super nice. I have been here several times and always loved my food. I had a tasteless to-go pasta experience that was cold by the time I got home from my 5-minute commute. I let management know and they offered me $25 gift card comp for the $50 meal- that never came. So 1 star was deducted for bad customer service. The other star comes from my last in-house experience! I brought family from out of town, and she happened to order the Alfredo sauce (just like my boyfriend did during my bad to-go experience) and she was less than thrilled. She was totally embarrassed to tell the waitress she wasn't happy, but my waitress should have realized when she had only taken a few bites before ditching the whole plate and not interested in taking it to go. Stay away from the Alfredo! Pastey and flavorless. Pictured is the penne with vodka sauce and chicken with is my go to. Highly recommend!
Never heard of an Italian restaurant that has chicken parmigiana but doesn't offer veal parmigiana.
The BEST hands down! Nothing compares to this bakery in the area. My family loves it here.

If I could give this restaurant zero stars, I would. Very disappointing service - we literally watched our drinks sit at the bar for 10+ minutes. All of the food we ordered came out at the same time even though we specified how we wanted it served. Will not be returning.

Why 4 stars? Because it's good for fast food, but I don't need to return.

   ---   ---   ---

I'd heard about Jollibee as soon as it was rumored that we might be getting one in Tampa Bay. I'll be honest and say that I knew nothing about it, other than the fact that it had a cult following and that it was a pretty big deal that we were getting one. I don't find myself in Pinellas Park often, but we were visiting a friend nearby and headed over afterward for an early dinner.

Jollibee's menu is pretty much fried chicken and/or spaghetti. Not a combination you'll be likely to find at any other restaurant in the world, so that's kind of a fun starting point. We ordered both.

I thought the fried chicken was pretty typical for fast food. Maybe a notch about the KFC's of the world. 

I enjoyed the spaghetti a bit more because it was unique. The sauce had a hint of sweetness to it and mixed in the midst of the noodles, sauce and cheese were small bits of hot dog meat. Again, it was unique. But it worked!

We also couldn't go without the signature dessert item: a peach and mango pie. It's similar to something you'd find at McDonald's - a hot pocket with fruit filling. It was okay - it didn't really scratch my sweet tooth itch.

And lastly, I enjoyed the tasty Pineapple Quencher for my drink. It was a nice combination of sweet and tangy. It was kind of like a Pineapple Fanta.

I've probably had fast food less than 10 times in the past 10 years, if you don't count places like PDQ and

We enjoy visiting or ordering from Italia about once a month. The location and atmosphere are family-friendly East Nashville. The pizza is consistently good, and the garlic knots are amazing. Truly amazing. They're crispy outside, soft inside, and deliciously addictive, with Parmesan and a bit of fresh basil outside. A hidden feature is Italia's selection of Greek and middle eastern entrees; the falafels and dolmas are great. I wish Italia served beer and wine.

SOHO Juice is the best place for a healthy treat. They are generous with the toppings and are always so friendly. My personal favorite is the açaí bowl but the cloud 9 bowl is a close second.

Recently tried their waffles that came out, the grandma is definitely my favorite. The best part of them is that they are VEGAN! Gluten-free and Dairy Free Coconut whip. The perfect treat for those with allergies and food sensitivities. 

Overall there aren't many "dessert" or sweet treat places in the Tampa area with dairy free options. It's definitely a growing market but soho is one place in the area with lots of options.

Service was great, portion sizes were huge (kid burrito was only $3.50 and came out looking like 2/3 the size of my burrito), and it's kid-friendly (crayons and coloring paper included)! Wish i took a picture of my burrito, but if it helps, it was bigger than my niece's burrito and was darn good! Downside: chips and salsa don't come complimentary, but the company was great and so was the food and service. Cheers!

I attempted to place a carry-out order for a margarita (that's all) 30 minutes before they closed. A woman answered and she said "we're closed" and hung up immediately. So, I called back and a man answered the phone and told me they closed 30 minutes early. I just think it's bad customer service to turn down customers 30 minutes before the store closes. It's very unprofessional and it makes me feel like they don't care about their customers. Usually, experience great service, however, tonight was horrible amd extremely upsetting.

Great pizza! The wings were terrible. Seems most pizza places have a hard time getting the wings right, not enough sauce and was tasteless. The ranch has to much dill in it and did nothing to enhance the pizza. Not sure why people go off the cuff when creating a ranch recipe. Think Hidden Valley and go from there. Overall 5 stars based soley off pizza.

I brought a large party in for a birthday celebration in November.    Last night I went back for my
Birthday celebration.   We viewed the wine list and inquired about several.   Were told we could have none.   Every wine we asked for "was not available".  Our waiter told us that "they" said they would sell us a bottle for double the price of what we asked for.   Declined but they brought us a glass carafe of wine that was below expectation and most likely boxed wine   Very low standards for a place I was just at.   Bring your own.  We left as soon as dinner was done and declined dessert and coffee because the birthday experience was falling short.   Just a completely different experience from the month before.   Hit or miss.

Been here twice. Once for lunch and once for dinner. Dinner was good, service was good. Lunch was not as good service was ok but I ordered a cilantro steak sandwich and it was mostly fat and uneatable. Made me loose my appetite. If the owners read these reviews, you may consider buying your skirt steak from a different vendor. Or trim the fat off it before cooking. Very disappointing.

Ten (10) ladies arrived at the restaurant and were immediately met by Stacie. She brought two tables together and sat all of us. She took our drink orders. She took our meal orders. She attended to us quickly and checked on us several times. We asked for separate checks and she replied, no problem. She took pictures of us at the end of the night. Stacie was the best waitress we have had in a long time. She was very pleasant. Oh and BTW, our meals were yummy. We will be back.

Fun, delicious, homey... Sign me up. Their Bloody Mary is by far the best I've had in New Orleans, if not anywhere. They're making me step my Mary-making game up! 

If you're coming to dine or enjoy a drink inside, then come on in. If you want a drink to go, they have a convenient bar 1-2 doors down (in the Square) that you can order to go. I love you, New Orleans. Our first morning back in New Orleans, we came in for breakfast. Our table devoured Eggs Stanley, Breaux Bridge Benedict, Stanley Classic x2, Pancakes, Eggs Benedict Poor Boy, and one other dish I can't remember. If you get any kind of Benedict, be sure to ask for more hollandaise. They provide plenty on the plate, but it's so good you will want to sop everything in it! There was nothing left on any of our plates! Don't think they're cheap on their portions, because trust me they are just right! We just enjoyed the food that much that we ate everything! Drinks consisted of 3 Bloody Mary's, a Coke (that was never empty), coffee (same with always being full), and an Abita Hopitoulas IPA that really makes you want to drown yourself in a pool of it. Now.. pronounce it with me... HOP-ih-TOO-lus. So you can sound like a local ;) 

Stanley is another must-go-to when you're in New Orleans. Nothing beats their food, drinks, and most importantly to me their hospitality. By the time you leave, you're laughing with and have become friends with your wait staff.

The food is not as good as previous times we ate there. It seems like new owners . Some of the items are no longer on the menu.  The take out order was incorrect but we didn't go back because of the driving distance. 
Not our favorite Chinese restaurant anymore

Came here because we were looking for a tomato pie. Was trying to find it in the bakery on the same block but they were closed on Sunday early. So glad we checked this place out. There were many people in and out the small place constantly, which is always a good sign. We got the tomato pizza with no cheese. Yes, we were specifically looking for "marinara slice". It was beyond my expectations! The pie was very large and has tons of tomato sauce on it. It was not overly sweet and has nice roast garlic slice. We chowed down the whole pie with no problem and it was so delicious. Definitely recommend!

The bacon wrapped scallops were perfectly cooked. I enjoyed a veggie burger and my husband had a landfill burger. Everything was cooked very well and had a lot of flavor. We had funnel fries for dessert. They are worth trying for sure! It is very casual and nothing fancy. I will come again!

Mooyah was so delicious! First time here so I went with a classic meal, Mooyah cheeseburger. These are great steak burgers! If you're looking for a good steak burger but still wanna do fast food, come to this place. They also have other locations throughout the city if you don't want to make a trip to the Riverwalk! Ps. Their potato fries are so crispy and made just right. They also have the option of sweet potato fries.

For years, I've seen the red barn structure at the corner of Florida and Hillsborough Avenue, and I've always wanted to check it out. With a little extra time in my schedule last week, I finally made my way in to the Seminole Heights General Store.

From the outside, it looks like a Cracker Barrel and the inside is no different. Indeed it is a barn. The interior dining area, humbly furnished , revisits a simpler time of mid 60's era decor that was probably was obtained from 80's yard sales. Kitschy, yes. Cute and fitting of the uber-hip neighborhood, most certainly.

My daughter and I ordered a few breakfast sandwiches to go. The sandwiches are HUGE! If it is just you and your partner stopping in for a bite, consider getting just one sandwich. They really are that big. Also don't go in a hurry if you order the breakfast sandwich, everything is made fresh from scratch and takes a little extra time. In the meantime...wander around. There is plenty to look at.

The Seminole Heights General Store also has a limited collection of local craft brews available, some of which you can't find at any other location other than the brewer itself. It was too early for a beer during my visit, but I did take a 6 pack home.

I'll admit that I was a bit disappointed that the staff was not wearing masks while making our food. If fact, it was really the only blemish on an otherwise fantastic and enjoyable experience. In this day and age I would hope that all restaurants make an effort to be more

Never again they take too long for bull crap food. No branding on take out containers. Bad food cold food. It's boarder line poppy store, bodegas food. I can tell they are not clean in there also. Uniforms very dirty and untidy workers.

They were so accommodating especially with COVID going on. They had outside seating that was distanced and though you had to wear a mask as soon as you got to the table you could take it off. The staff was sweet and very nice about everything. Can't wait to come back!

What an unexpected surprise to find a place with authentic Russian food of such a high caliber. You can taste and feel how much love is put into the food here! The chefs and wait staff was attentive and genuinely interested in our feedback on their food. 
Highlights include a ground beef and mushroom blini that was cooked to perfection and packed full of flavor, a marinated carrot side dish that blew us away, and the finale being a honey cake that tasted like absolute heaven....  
Don't be scared of any of the food, everything we ordered exceeded our expectations and we're going back next week to try the stroganoff!!! 
Thank you Elena and crew!!!! Simply wonderful!

I've been here twice in the past month!  Each time with larger groups and they were able to accommodate us. Even if we had to practice social distancing. Waiter was very friendly and suggested we try the "cazuela" drink. Super attentive and welcoming staff.  We tried a few different items and they were all very tasty. 
Lengua en salsa verde 5 stars 
Asada fries 5 stars 
Sopes 5 stars 
Molcajete 5 stars 
Bistec encebollado 5 stars 
Breakfast chorizo burrito 5 stars 
Shrimp fajitas 5 stars 
Carnitas plate 5 stars 
I can go on and on but you guessed it 5 stars across the board
Great venue, food was delicious, staff was courteous. There was a lot of people, bring your patience cap.
Order was accurate, great tasting and fast delivery. There sushi was good but there hot foods such as the fried rice and the orange chicken was exceptional!

Hidden Gem!!!  If you want to know the good places to eat...ask a local.  Everyone recommended Deenie's (great) and Monty's (great) and a host of other really good places... but it took a "late night, everything is closed, what are we going to eat, ask a local" situation to get us to Verti Marte... and baaaabbbyyy!!!  When I tell you their Shrimp Philly is other worldly!!!!

So, it reminds me of a New York bodega... you heard me.  It's not a restaurant... it's more like a quickie mart... only smaller and dingier.  LOL.  You have to turn sideways to fit through the aisles.  But once you shuffle to the back and see the menu.... Man, there are like 12,000 options on the menu.  My first thought was  "There is no way they can do all of this well".  My second thought was  "I'll probably get e-coli, but whatever... I'm on vacation"  

The nicest people I ever met run the spot.  They know that the food is amazing... so, they know you'll be back.  LOL  They treat you like they're going to see you again tomorrow....AND THEY DID!!! I was due to leave the very next day, but had to stop for another Shrimp Philly before departing NOLA.  

Their most popular sandwich is the All That Jazz.  Everyone in line was raving about it, apparently it's turkey ham and shrimp.  Sounds interesting, but I don't eat pork, so I got the Shrimp Philly instead... and was so happy I did!  It is huge, and loaded with Shrimp.  When we went back the next day, we shared one sandwich.

I'm now anxious to try the ot

I can't speak to the food but the service was nonexistent. A friend and I came in for brunch on a Saturday morning in October. There were a few people at the bar but otherwise the place was empty. There was a bartender and a waiter but neither helped us or even looked up from what they were doing. We sat down at the bar and were ignored for another 10 minutes, so we left. Went to Royal House instead. Good food and friendly efficient staff there. Highly recommend Royal House.

Drinks are always great. The live music was good too. I personally think their food isn't that great. It doesn't have much flavor to it. For the same price you can go somewhere in Nashville that isn't everywhere else in the country. Our server was a sweetie though!

This may be our new favorite local sushi spot in Franklin. We've only ordered once but had a great experience. We called in a to go order on a Saturday night and it was ready in 20-30 minutes. We ordered 2 rolls each. I got the Philadelphia roll and Jay's roll and I would definitely order these again! Everything tasted fresh and flavorful. Finding a quality sushi restaurant is always nerve wracking (especially in middle TN), but I think this may be it. We can't wait to try them again!

Looking for this place is not easy because we did not expected the entrance was inside the mall building. Additional parkings are in the back of the building.!!! This is important for people who does not parallel park. 
After walking in, we were greeted by the very friendly waitress who lead us to our table. The decoration was right on the rustic farm house look. I love it! We had order an appetizer of a cheese platter. With that it comes with five cheeses. It was awesome! We really enjoyed that. I also order a caramelized cauliflower dish. That was just alright. For the group of us some ordered soup with sandwich entree. I ordered a Sourdough grilled turkey sandwich. Someone else order of foliage omelette. Short rib. Everyone seemed to enjoy their dinner. Their foods were delicious. However, it is on the salty side. For my sandwich, it was a little oily. A little touch of dressing will make it more flavorful. for dessert, we chose a black Berry tart. It was awesome. Even came with a scoop of ice cream. Everybody seemed to enjoy it.
Overall, it was a good experience. I will definitely go back with my friends again. I love the atmosphere, the friendliness of the staffs, the service and the dessert. Definitely don't forget to check in, because you get the dessert for free.

Phe.No.Men.Al. I am so grateful to have this place in Nashville - I live in Franklin and my hubby and I regularly make the trip to green hills to eat here - the mall is a secondary attraction . Talk about delicious authentic tasting Italian food. Everything I've had here is amazing- the burrata, prosciutto bruschetta, all of the pastas, the calamari.. the drink menu is probably my favorite in the whole county since I love aperal spirtz- they have all kinds of spritz variations. Although since I'm pregnant I asked for a mock tail today and the guy serving us made me the most delicious drink with muddled cucumber, mint and pineapple- my husband asked for one too! Love this place - if you haven't been, you are definitely missing out :)

The cream puffs are amazing here! All the flavors taste great, but pistachio is my favorite. I have tried banana, pumpkin, vanilla, strawberry, chocolate, and pistachio cream puffs. It's super light and airy and doesn't taste artificial at all. The staff is friendly and helpful.

Hands-down one of the best burgers I've had in a long time. Fharmacy burgers do not disappoint. Given the public health crisis, we were only able to get take-out, but it was even more impressive because of it. In a lot of other places, take-out burgers kindda fall apart in the box or get flattened out but Fharmacy's was almost impeccable all the way to my dining table. Friendly service and efficient over-the-phone ordering and pick up.  

It's important to support the people running small businesses and eateries in the community. Fharmacy makes it to the top of my list.

Verdict: Woohoo! As good as it gets!

Honestly we really like it there but the last visit tonight was awful. We had a waitress who Took 10m to get our order. 20m before we got our 1st round of drinks. The table that came in after us got there order and drinks before us. We ordered appetizers which came in 25m which we we're ok with. Then we waited 23 m and asked where our entrees were. Were told ossu Boca takes longer. Keep in mind this was the 5th time we ordered it and never took that long. 42m+. Got it to go along my fish tacos. Got home. And the ossu bocu was deep fried since it was really crunchy. We go there 2-3x per month and never got such bad service even w manager intervention that stuck up w the horrible waitress. Had to call 4x before even got a person on and was told the GM went home after saying he was in a meeting. Called when we were told he would be there.

Excellent service.  Great atmosphere (friendly, a bit loud actually, but not stuffy). Honestly, as a "steakhouse" guy, this was still one of the best steaks I've had.

Great experience, great service, with great food.

The dinning area reopened after the locked down.  This place always clean and most here are for take out, so social distancing for dine in is not an issue.  However, they added 50 cents for all sandwiches due to meat shortage.  I don't see other places doing this.  You be the judge on that.  The drinks and sandwich are good, but the fried rice is a let down. Basically a thin scrambled egg on the bottom, then put white rice on top with meat on the side.  That is not fried rice to me.  Also, it is considered expensive and I should have just walked to the next store and get a much better fried rice.

I wanted to get a pastry for dessert and decided to pop into Andersen's to see what they had. The lady at the counter was kind and offered up samples for me to try. What won me over was their Princess Cake. It's seriously the best!! It's layered with marzipan and is so moist. My new fave!!
Great pizza and coupon deal. I'd go back just for the $20 large pie, sticks, and salad.
I love the boneless wings here. Very good sauce. Very good blue cheese. Couldnt ask for anything better.

BEAST is doing an amazing job serving customers during times of COVID! The gentleman at the window made sure we were taken care of with drinks while we decided what to order and gave recommendations on what to choose. The pulled pork was so tender and the wings were juicy. They were taking great care and we felt very safe eating there. We will be back!

Superb, wood fired New York style pizza; you will find nothing else like this in SB. Super-thin, perfectly crisp and chewy crust, simple and slightly tart sauce that tastes like fresh crushed tomatoes, just the right ratio of toppings - to die for. The XL pizzas are enormous and the Cesar salad dressing is tangy and made fresh. I know because I had to wait once when they ran out and had to make it. They have a smallish seating area that has never been crowded the times I have been.

Service is a little impersonal, and the name continues to trip me up; Lilsy, Lil-Z or...I'll deal for the quality and taste of their pies!

I became a fan back in my college days and have stayed a big fan and supporter of Dunderbak's for 6+ years. Everything I have ever tried from here has been excellent. My favorites are the jaeger schnitzel, pierogies, potato pancakes and the Spaetzel: they have a huge variety of beers on tap and you can also get growlers togo.
This place is under new management, it's so much better now. Food and service take a major step up. Love the sushi, taste great and fresh. Highly recommended!!!

One of my fav asian restaurants. A little pricey for what your getting but good. Staff is very attentive & the manager is very accommodating. 
I recommend the Gen Tso chicken & the okra.

I went to pick up my food during the quarantine. The guy came out right away and was super friendly. The checkbooks and pens were sanitized. I thought I ordered a salad but apparently I didn't add it. Anyways they ended up giving me one for free and really appreciated the business. The food was delicious as always!!!

We had dinner after a soccer match at Lincoln Field and it was packed. We were lucky enough to have Vienna as our server - she was amazing! It is hard to articulate what perfect service is but she provided it. We got our drinks and food quickly. She was personable, professional and just overall awesome. I never would think I'd recommend this place but she made it such a great experience we would go back in a heartbeat. Thanks Vienna!

I started going here during the beginning of COVID. We wanted to support local and ordered out at least 2-3x weekly. This is now a standard go to when we have guests over. We can order multiple items and share Greek food with everyone. There is nothing that you will not like. The only complaint I have ever had with OPA is that the tilapia pasta is a little oily, but the dressing is oil, so there ya go! I still order it and top with fresh parmesan that they give you! Go, enjoy and continue to tip your servers well.

Once again mambos was great. The food was on point and i did not know they had mustard greens there. Those greens were absolutely delicious. Definitely try this spot out if you touch down in french qtrs

This deli is like no other. 

Forget your normal deli order: "Turkey and Swiss on a French roll with....."

The menu is kinda strange, but the taste of their creations is out of this world. (You gotta try the Trevor Special) I have not had a bad thing there yet. 

Love the food, love the friendly folks behind the counter and love the atmosphere. 

Highly recommend.

I visited with a friend on a busy Saturday afternoon. Let me begin my saying I love the atmosphere of La Boulangerie. Little round tables are spread around a large open space and the weekend bustle added to the charm. 
We ordered at the counter. The cashier was a little apathetic and not engaging - but I sympathize with this, being in the food service industry myself - it was a busy Saturday and they probably just wanted to go home. I was disappointed in the pastries. We tried three things - a plain croissant, the mushroom and brie baguette and the broccoli stromboli. The croissant was overbaked and all the butter had melted away, leaving a crunchy shell of pastry with a giant air pocket in the center. The stuffed baguette was okay but not very flavorful. The broccoli pastry was also over baked and the overwhelming flavor was of salt. The coffee was delicious. It's entirely possible that it was just an off-day at La Boulangerie and I will definitely give the bakery another shot.

I came here for a quick lunch with my girlfriends and Kristin was our server. We were short on time, but she accommodated us despite being busy herself. Our drinks were never empty, food was fantastic as always, and she had our checks ready to go when we needed them. She even offered us togo sodas before we left! Their lunch special is a great deal and awesome if you're on a time crunch. If you have the time to wait for a pizza, try their pacific rim. You won't be disappointed! =)

We booked a Sunday brunch reservation with Boathouse for a Bach weekend I was throwing a good friend of mine. I called and let them know it was a special occasion and that I wanted to make the meal very special for the bride. 

After being told this place doesn't take reservations on the weekends I was disappointed but willing to still make it to Boathouse and wait for such a great place. Checked their site and left an email on their inquiry page requesting for the reservation for our large group and hoped that they would make an exception. Sure enough they emailed me and called me back. They let me know they were going to be able to set the reservation but not only that, they also offered us a table VIP bottle service at their local club spot Indocine for the night before our reservation. This was such a great surprise and delight! Of course we took them up on their offer and changed our night plans to make sure to stop in for the table service. I loved that they offered such a special just because we were dining with them and celebrating such an occasion. Goes to show... you should always tell people if youre celebrating a special occasion. 

The club was locally known as a not so upscale place and definitely didn't have the reputation my friend would want to go to - solely because she's a more wholesome gal.... and yet Boathouse exceeded our expectations again! The club played a great mix of hip hop and old 90 classic songs that made us feel very young again and overall ha
Just tried to call three times and someone answered, waited two seconds and hung up.  Not great customer service!
Went here for restaurant week and all the food was amazing and very high end! Service was fast and very accommodating.
Good food, could tell menu had been pared down due to virus.   Very quiet on Sunday evening.   Potato would be nice seating when warm outside.   Saw people with small pet in that area outside.

I went for pickup and the process was pretty seamless. You order online and go pick it up. They have a table outside which is great because your food is waiting for you when you get there. I got the Bistro Beef and the chickpea soup. The sandwich was AMAZING.  Give it a shot.
Just ordered delivery - so yummy. Definitely recommend the sample platter and chicken kababs. Will be eating here again soon!!

The line is worth it--and not as bad as it looks on a Sunday morning! Once you get in there, service is amazing. The servers are so kind and patient, even among the chaos. As a local, I appreciate a no fluff experience sometimes. Just get your amazing pancakes (try their cinnamon syrup) and all the sides you need. The grits could've been better, but still a must try considering I'm not one to talk having grown up without every having grits.

First time here the other night and it's legit the best bar/hang out spot I've ever been. More often than not (and also due to proximity) my friends and I frequent the dives on the LES in NYC. This place blows them away....easily. LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!!

Fantastic Service!!! Great food. I've had my eye on this restaurant for a while and finally was able to make time to come in. The waitress was fantastic, she suggested I try a few wines before I decide, she was fast and efficient even if the restaurant was packed. I will absolutely make this our, new date night, go to from now on! Thank you so much!

First time having Illy coffee. I had a latte. The coffee tastes pretty good. It's more of a bold flavored coffee, which I prefer. I also had a almond croissant. The croissant pastry dough was good, however the inside of the croissant "almond" flavoring was odd to me. I've had almond croissants before & it's usually a thin smear of flavoring. This one was thick & doughy, sort of reminded me of the texture of a sugar cookie, except less chewy. They did have several other bakery items that looked tasty though & the 2 employees I encountered were very friendly.    I would go back for the coffee & to try other bakery items.

Great Korean market. Love the authentic and delicious food we get for take out. If you like Korean food you will love Choi's market. If you have not tried it, do yourself a favor and check it out. You won't be disappointed.

Appetizers were great...

HOWEVER, dinner was an epic fail.  Food was very inconsistent with the price and the atmosphere.  Salmon was overcooked, mashed potatoes had no flavor.  Lobster was overcooked, and cioppino was just plain gross.  They offered dessert on the house, and we received a chocolate cake that reminded me of pepperidge farm frozen cakes.....gross

Too bad I was looking forward to a nice meal......

After a million hours of searching for breakfast through yelp in Santa Barbara, my girlfriend and I found this great spot. We came for the French Toast and it was really good! BUT we both ended up loving the BREAKFAST BURRITO!?! Both portions were fairly big and we split both in half. The waitress was super nice. We had the choice of eating at 1 table inside but decided to sit outside instead. The prices are very fair and I definitely would recommend coming here. If ever I'm back in SB, I will be getting the breakfast burrito again!
Been here twice and both meals were fantastic. If you go, get the Honey Badger - it's one of a kind and worth the visit!
Everything tasted fresh! Good service and prices. Crab Rangoon and cucumber salad were my favorite!
Great food!! Great service! A must stop when in NOLA! Highly recommend the charbroiled oysters. Myron gives the best service!!

Service and food is good. Very reasonable price for burger place. My first time being here but love the place. Def will come to visit more. Ahi tuna bowl is fresh and tasty. My BF loves his burger as well.

This is a small spot next to bourbon st. The kitchen, where you order, is all the way in the back. I went during the daytime so it was empty. The bar is the first section of the grill ( not pictured ) and then there is a seating area in the back which was very pretty. The food was pretty decent. Definitely good meals for after drinking.

I has a great time here!  The food was amazing.   The atmosphere was casual and fun with long term roots in the community.   We went during lunch so there was only one server on the floor and she did a great job taking care of the customers.
Fries were cold and stale.... customer service was the worst. Clearly we were annoying the staff and management by being there. They need some change at that store!
Love their ice cream, especially the specialty flavors! Try German Chocolate and caramel swirled together, so good!!!

I was a loyal customer if the Tampa location and couldn't have been more excited about the Brandon location! Luckily they kept the same standards and quality that I was used to! I particularly love the Pork bulgogi and fish cakes (Trust me they are awesome!)

I got the farmhouse biscuit sandwich. The biscuit is good - big, buttery and soft. However, the filling is overwhelming. Sausage, ham, scrambled egg, caramelized onion, tomato jam, arugula... There are too many ingredients and their flavors just don't come along well. I ended up eating each ingredient separately.

Sometimes, simplicity wins.

This is by far the best sushi place around! Service is great (if you sit at the sushi bar the owner will sometimes let you try his new creations to get your opinion!! Bonus!). The specialty rolls are unique and delicious. Everything here is wonderful and no other place comes close

Ravanesi serves the best pizza in the area, with the delicious dough AND cheese made in-house. We finally had our chance to try it for the first time since prior to the pandemic, they were not taking reservations or takeout, but now they are, and I am thrilled. You must call a few days or a week ahead to reserve your time slot to pick up the pizzas. When the owner found out it was my first time trying the pizzas, he sounded worried that we would be getting takeout since neopolitan style pizzas are best straight out of the oven. He reminded me of myself, because I am the same way when serving food. It's like the time my husband brought butternut squash gnocchi with sage brown butter sauce to work and did not bring the parmigiano cheese . When I arrived to pick up the pizza, he actually made me a mini white pizza to eat in the car! I couldn't believe it haha it was so kind of him. I ate the entire thing within 2 minutes-- it was excellent. I arrived home with the pizzas at the same time my husband arrived home from work, we ate them right away, and they were perfect! My husband said Ravanesi might be his favorite pizza thus far (and we have eaten A LOT of different pizzas, all over the world.) I cannot recommend Ravanesi pizza enough, and I cannot wait to eat here again. Amazing.

Always get food that tastes fresh from here no matter when I go. They have lots of very delicious vegetarian options. The Thom Yum soup tastes authentic and that alone is worth the trip. Always have the most flavorful dishes. Highly recommend.

We came to town for a concert on Sept 26th which wound up being postponed till March. The food here was outstanding and the service was great. The only complaint I have is we were unable to push our reservation to a later time when if fact the place was no way near full.

Hidden gym of New Orleans East, came here for the first time for a fish and shrimp plate, cause you know we gotta have our seafood on Fridays, and I was surely satisfied! $11.95 (plus tax) is a good price and you get tail on shrimp! My favorite! It comes with fries and a drink and a nice sized, individually packed side salad (House or Caesar). I also got the Smiley lunch rum punch and it's got a kick to it! The bartender added an extra kick. Inside atmosphere is at home and relaxed. Can't believe it took me this long to come check

To the owner: Please open one up in North Jersey! It would be a fantastic location thats always busy. 
When I lived in Delaware, I survived off of El Diablo. It is hands down the best Mexican fast food I have ever had. From the burritos to quesadillas to the entire menu, it will make you drool. 
The honey jalapeno sauce? To die for. I wish they sold it, I would buy an ungodly amount and ship it to me in New Jersey. 
The cirtrus braised pork burrito will send you straight to food lovers heaven. Also the lime grilled steak burrito or tacos are amazing as well. I always get chips, queso, and guac to go and they never ever skimp out on the guac or queso. Every experience I had here was beyond amazing. The food beyond great quality. I can't wait to return!

Was in the mood for tacos and recently went here for the first time. El Taco Loco is a nice little place to grab some tacos for cheap. 

PROS: Fast service, friendly staff, and solid pricing! You can get 2 tacos for $4, so I got 4 for $8. They have an extras bar where you can grab salsas, sauces, jalapeños, and limes. Handful of seating with music playing often. Staff was very friendly, they overcharged me and once I brought it up they were happy to fix the problem. 

CONS: The Carnitas tacos was a little under-seasoned, and the Chorizo is very oily so it can make the soft shell break easily. 

Overall I'd come back! The food was very filling for the price and the topping options were very vast making it more food than you think.

I ate dinner here a few days ago. I ordered the souvlaki chicken sandwich ($9) and an Italian soda ($3.25). The pita sandwich was OK, but I think I prefer their roast chicken over their souvlaki chicken. This is a nice spot for pre- or post-movie meals due to its location right across the street from the Loft Cinema. It doesn't have much competition within easy walking distance of the theater.

I come here every time I am in Philly .
Gorgeous food . Simple , fresh , abundant .
Reasonable prices , laid back atmosphere excellent

place was absolutely awful. service was good and that's the only reason i gave it one  star. place was made in the 1960s and the decor wasn't updated since. the food was awful, they messed up raviolis. how can you mess up a ravioli? i went to order a steak and the waitress told me the cooks didn't even know how to cook a steak. i had the chicken parm with pasta and am currently pissing out of my ass. awful place with awful food. would never go back.

I was in town visiting family and this place 2qs highly recommended. I now understand why. The best food I've had in a while! The drinks were amazing (and strong) and the chicken mole enchiladas were superb. My friend got the octopus and when the server took off the lid the entire patio was engulfed in an amazing smell. The outdoor seating area has views of the ocean. I will be back!!

This place is a really cool boba spot that has figured out a good solution to serving boba safely considering the times. You order ahead and call when you get there and they bring the tea out to you. I was not super thrilled with my drink choice- I wanted milk tea but accidentally ordered the brown sugar milk. It was good, but not what I wanted. However, it was good enough and the experience was good enough that I will definitely be back to try again! This time making sure I ordered the right thing!

Horrible service during happy hour before a game. Our first clue should have been the lack of people in the restaurant an hour before game time. Waited at the bar for service, got our food but couldn't eat while we waited for utensils. Ordered a drink that was not served as described. Food was ok. Strange smell and walls look worn. Not recommended, which is sad because we live other locations!
Lovveee the pho chin! I always get it togo and they are very good about giving me extra bean sprouts and limes. Always super fast! Tastes amazing every time!

We came back for a second attempt, and the food was super bland. The best part of our meals was the bread at the beginning - even the homemade Caesar dressing was bad. The hostess was pretty inhospitable when we came in, but our waitress was ok. If they were priced better you could forgive them for tasting like Olive Garden, but the food here is too flavorless to justify the expense.

Hello I visited this place today I was little bit dawn and Looking for good lunch TG I find it the personal is friendly and food was delish the Chicken soup,fish taco and a hot tea definitely made me feel better thank you and looking forward to came back soon

I love the tacos here! They are far from traditional Mexican style tacos, however the ingredients are fresh and tasty. My husband doesn't like Roscoe's, he says the food is bland, but if you add texas fire it spices it right up! I would give it a try, tasty food, great service, what's not to love!

I had a Mexican plate for lunch.... the food came out quickly and the food was delicious and the portion size generous (enough for two meals).

I would absolutely eat here again.... was nervous to after seeing some of the reviews but outside of needing a little tlc with the decor this is a good place for a meal

Ordered salted and fresh pork hot pot to be delivered to my house. Charged $14.95 with two pieces of green leaves, 4 pieces of un-chewable bamboo shoots and "purple" pork belly... are you kidding me?! I've been a returning customer and always get good service when I'm dining in. I'm very shocking to see the poor quality of the take-out service. Very sad about this.

We had anniversary dinner there last night and had a great experience. The food great and a very good wine list, leaning towards Italian varietals. The focaccia bread was the best I ever had. Service was friendly and efficient.

The food is indeed fresh and the menu has everything I'm used to. Except there's no chicken satay. Weird. But the Tom Kha Gai is silky sweet and just hot enough (I got it at a 2). The Pad See Ewe is my wife's favorite. Sister loved the Orange Chicken and Brother-in-law thought the Pad Thai was yummy. Love the laid back atmosphere and the servers are very nice. It wasn't terribly busy when we went there on a Wednesday night but they had a steady carryout crowd.
Went for the first time and it was amazing! Great atmosphere, employees and food!! I will definitely go again!

I met some friends at Roy's for their "Aloha" happy hour on a Monday afternoon. The happy hour goes from 3-7. Both bartenders (totally forgot to get their names) were super attentive and made great suggestions! I had a few glasses of wine and the wagyu sliders which happened to come with truffle fries for $8, such a great deal! The happy hour drinks range from $4 (beer) to $8 (special cocktails). The happy hour food ranges from $8-$12 depending on what you get. They had sushi, vegetable starters, and some beef/chicken options. This was my first time at Roy's, and I'll definitely be back for happy hour soon!

If I could give zero stars I would. Ordered delivery for my family. Five minutes AFTER scheduled delivery time, I got a one line email saying the delivery was canceled. No call, no explanation. Ridiculous.
